Duniya sabko todti hai, aur baad me, bahut log broken jagahon par strong ban jaate hain.
Himmat darr ka hona nahi, usse ladna hai.
Grit thandi hai.
Fear itna hi deep jitna mind allow karta.
Lambe raaste se mat daro.
Grit arena mein rehna hai.
Jo lagta hai nahi ho sakta, wohi karna hoga.
Grit kabhi haar nahi maanti.
Grit kendra hai.
Khamoshi energy bachane ka tareeqa.
Khamoshi ki aawaz hi sabse geheri garjan hoti hai.
Safalta antim nahi hai, vipalta ghatak nahi hai: aage badhte rehne ka saahas hi maayne rakhta hai.
Grit kamyabi ko indhan deti hai.
Smooth sea se skilled sailor nahi banta.
Khamoshi sanctuary hai.
Himmat be-darr hone ki kala hai.
Asli taqat shant dil mein basti hai.
Khud banne ki himmat karna hai.
Tum nayi horizons ke liye tabhi swim kar sakte ho jab shore ki nazar hataane ka courage ho.
